children.name: Ficalhoa laurifolia Hiern
children.description: The only species of the genus Ficalhoa (family Sladeniaceae), an evergreen tree with glabrous branches, roughly fissured bark exuding white latex, and leathery lanceolate leaves; its small flowers are white, yellowish or greenish. An Afromontane forest tree of tropical Africa growing at roughly 1,200-2,800 m in mountains such as the Udzungwa and Rwenzori ranges, it is among the commonest trees in parts of the Rwenzori. IUCN: Least Concern.
